popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Panthous is a Trojan elder and priest of Apollo — father of Polydamas, Euphorbus, and Hyperenor, the counselor whose sons fight and fall beside Hector.

popCulture.title: Panthous
popCulture.description: Priest of Apollo at Troy, son of Othrys — the elder whose house supplies Hector's wisest friend and the warrior who wounds Patroclus.

popCulture.title: Polydamas
popCulture.description: Panthous' son — Hector's cautious counselor whose good advice the hero too often refuses.

popCulture.title: Euphorbus
popCulture.description: Panthous' son — the Trojan who first wounds Patroclus before Hector delivers the killing blow; later claimed in Pythagorean transmigration lore.
